authorization: User requested pre-GPU work only. Stop here until a current GPU resource and execution authority are confirmed.
purpose: One real five-request engineering closed-loop qualification, not model research, Train tuning or Eval.

warmup.metrics_scope: Excluded from the five-request cohort, included in setup/full wall.

qualification.shared_S: One future actual-host monotonic start selected after preparation and warmup drain; never retimed on late entry.
qualification.separate_operator_permit: Bound to exact source/protocol/run/clock; existing window constraints unchanged.

live_preflight_required: A currently available, explicitly authorized GPU; no automatic rental.
Exact source/entrypoint/adapter/protocol hashes checked on the actual host before traffic.
Real assets/tokenizer/backend argv and package identity verified, not inferred from historical records.
Both declared ownership locks acquired; no unresolved owner and no foreign GPU workload.
Dedicated ports18000/18001 available; unrelated nginx8001 or other infrastructure left untouched.
Identical normal backend optimizations; no disabling graphs/compilation to ease the test.
Original deadline, reserve, cleanup and stop conditions preserved.

drain_contract.current_admitted_cost: Finite, nonnegative, <= 1e-9 with both request counters exactly zero.
drain_contract.numerical_tolerance_basis: Existing gateway ledger/closure abs_tol=1e-9; prevents normal floating-point remainder from wasting an otherwise idle run. Not a change to control guards, offered workload or Eval scoring.
drain_contract.busy_controls: Cost1e-6 or any request in flight remains busy.

acceptance: At least two consecutive timestamped observe/predict/plan/actual-first-action-application/reobserve cycles.
At least one changed applied cap affects a request admission decision, demonstrated by request/control budget versions and ordered reservation ledger.
All five scheduled offers retained with sent/not-launched/rejected/failed/unknown fates; no missing-to-zero or successful-request-only denominator.
Actual application within original source/entry/permit bounds, with no unresolved pending command.
Post-warmup and post-episode drain and zero tokenizer fallback verified.
Independent closed/complete ledger validation and GPU idle/STOPPED/known-gone receipts; cleanup failure stays a failure.
Controller and startup/drain/cleanup overhead recorded without changing offered arrival times.
failure_rule: Preserve raw and unscorable outcomes; no automatic retry, seed search, guard weakening or criteria edits.
Train_and_Eval: Do not execute either stage before qualification; Train Fixed freeze precedes held-out Eval. Negative performance remains acceptable.
